io.milvus.bulkwriter.storage

Interface StorageClient

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    AzureStorageClient, MinioStorageClient

    public interface StorageClient
    Defines the contract for uploading and inspecting bulk-import data files in remote/cloud storage.

    Implementations abstract the underlying cloud-storage SDK (S3-compatible services such as MinIO, or Azure Blob Storage), mapping data files to objects in a bucket and reporting object sizes, bucket existence, and upload progress.
